subject: Choosing model with large number of covariates based on AIC

messages.author: e54c74980a01d9ed
messages.subject: Choosing model with large number of covariates based on AIC
parts:
Hi everyone!

I am trying to model occupancy as a function of my 9 site-level landscape covariates. However, I am having trouble trying to figure out which model best fits. I would like to avoid typing all combinations of these covariates to check AIC individually. 

I have heard of fitList(), modSel(), and the MuMIn package that help users with model selection. However, in the examples I've seen, it has the user type out the combinations of covariates (ex. "developed + agriculture + aquatic" vs. "developed + agriculture" vs. "agriculture + aquatic"). Is there a way that these functions will do this for you?

Hopefully this makes sense!

Thanks in advance!
Maria
